title: The Quaker Oats legacy: 150 years of innovation, nutrition and trust
summary: A look at the milestones, products and purpose that helped make Quaker Oats a household favorite. Learn more about the history of Quaker Oats.
body_markdown:
The Quaker Oats Company’s story spans a century and a half: 2027 will mark 150 years since the Quaker trademark was first registered. Throughout the years, Quaker quickly became a brand of firsts — from innovative marketing tactics to creating new foods, the trusted Quaker Man has watched it all unfold with his trademark smile.
